name: quotes_english
_comment: Curated offline quote pack. Kept small on purpose: the shell reads this synchronously when the pack is selected.

quotes.text: Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.
A smooth sea never made a skilled sailor.
The future depends on what you do today.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
What you do speaks so loudly that I cannot hear what you say.
Any fool can write code that a computer can understand. Good programmers write code that humans can understand.
Premature optimization is the root of all evil.
There are only two hard things in computer science: cache invalidation and naming things.
Programs must be written for people to read, and only incidentally for machines to execute.
quotes.source: Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs

quotes.text: Simplicity is prerequisite for reliability.
The most damaging phrase in the language is: it has always been done that way.
Talk is cheap. Show me the code.
Controlling complexity is the essence of computer programming.
Everything should be made as simple as possible, but not simpler.
The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
It always seems impossible until it is done.
Fall seven times and stand up eight.
Whether you think you can or you think you cannot, you are right.
The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.
Perfection is achieved not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing left to take away.
If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.
Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do.
An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
The man who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
Quality is not an act, it is a habit.
You miss one hundred percent of the shots you do not take.
The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
Do not wait to strike till the iron is hot, but make it hot by striking.
I have not failed. I have just found ten thousand ways that will not work.
Discipline equals freedom.
Slow is smooth and smooth is fast.
Amateurs practice until they get it right. Professionals practice until they cannot get it wrong.
First, solve the problem. Then, write the code.
Make it work, make it right, make it fast.
Deleted code is debugged code.
Weeks of coding can save you hours of planning.
Testing shows the presence, not the absence of bugs.
The purpose of software engineering is to control complexity, not to create it.
Give me six hours to chop down a tree and I will spend the first four sharpening the axe.
What gets measured gets managed.
The obstacle is the way.
He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
No man ever steps in the same river twice, for it is not the same river and he is not the same man.
Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking.
Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labor does the body.
The impediment to action advances action; what stands in the way becomes the way.
Between stimulus and response there is a space, and in that space is our power to choose our response.
A person who never made a mistake never tried anything new.
If I have seen further, it is by standing on the shoulders of giants.
Science is a way of thinking much more than it is a body of knowledge.
Somewhere, something incredible is waiting to be known.
Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood.
The good thing about science is that it is true whether or not you believe in it.
Everything we call real is made of things that cannot be regarded as real.
The important thing is not to stop questioning. Curiosity has its own reason for existing.
